d.ko: What if you lost all your memories? An emotional family drama seen through the eyes of a woman with Alzheimer's disease. As Annie’s life slowly unravels, uncover memories of her deceased brother as her past bleeds into the present.
d.en: What if you lost all your memories? An emotional family drama seen through the eyes of a woman with Alzheimer's disease. As Annie’s life slowly unravels, uncover memories of her deceased brother as her past bleeds into the present.
d.zh: 如果失去了所有的记忆，你还能剩下什么？从罹患阿尔茨海默症的女性视角体验感人至深的家庭故事。随着安妮的人生缓缓展开，往事渐渐渗入现实，和她一同再次揭开关于逝去的弟弟的记忆。
